contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP [C ALLEC]TVS P[F ; R/ LAETIT[IA AV]G

Copper alloy coin. Possibly a quinarius of Allectus (293-296), RIC vol. 5 part 2 no. 124[F], ascribed to mint of Camulodunum (?C mint), Reece period 14. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right, short beard and long neck, seen from front. Obverse inscription: IMP [C ALLEC]TVS P[F omitted] AVG. Reverse description: possibly galley. Reverse inscription: LAETIT[IA AV]G. In exergue: Q C.…
